assessment.intent: Help Okanagan vacation-rental owners understand which photos, bed details, access notes, rules, dates and booking handoff a website needs to earn a direct enquiry.
assessment.specificity: Strong for the subject: it names exact page evidence such as room-by-room beds, parking clearance, deposits, request-versus-confirmation wording and a sample architecture.
assessment.evidence: Uses one relevant named project, Okanagan Treehouse, for design craft, and Tourism Kelowna as seasonal context. It does not invent test results, quotes or conversion figures.
assessment.voice: Clear, conversational and owner-focused. It explains tradeoffs without corporate padding and gives constructive recommendations rather than guaranteed outcomes.
assessment.usefulAsset: Yes. It is a practical buying and content guide with enough page-level detail for a vacation-rental owner to act on before asking for design help.
